money_effect.impact: positive median feedback and adequate promotion support risk appetite but do not prove candidate persistence

broken_loss_effect.impact: tail loss is contained, but failed-board mark-to-close loss still requires strict fill and exit discipline

height_feedback.impact: the prior space leader did not advance or the ladder is broken; current height names are emotion anchors, not automatic entries; aggregate one-price-board share describes crowding and buyability, but does not monotonically predict next-session deterioration

theme_divergence.impact: verified business membership can establish a same-chain roster, but only a separately verified active driver and frozen expectation can authorize formal competition or high-low mapping; secondary narratives remain descriptive only

repair_quality.impact: closing limit-up breadth expanded while failed-board pressure also rose; treat the repair as fragile and require stricter next-session confirmation

height_anchor_buyability_summary.interpretation: Highest-board identity is an emotion role, not proof of a buyable B+2 edge. Only if the corrected challenger beats boards-only metrics and daily selection under date-clustered intervals could a ranking claim be reconsidered.

opening_gap_payoff_summary.interpretation: Opening strength is a trade-off, not a monotonic buy factor. The 5-7% band has higher touch identity, while >7% contains more one-price/unbuyable rows and worse conditional loss. Neither 0-5% nor 5-7% authorizes entry without actual absorption, reseal, theme support and a valid price ceiling.

opening_gap_emotion_summary.interpretation: The 5-7% versus above-7% payoff difference changes across regimes and time segments; supportive, hot and adverse labels do not provide a stable waiver or automatic veto. Above-7% remains a buyability risk flag in every regime, while actual absorption, reseal, theme synchronization and price ceiling remain required.

weak_to_strong_hindsight_summary.interpretation: Low/flat opens have a much smaller full-denominator chance of reaching a buyable B+2-positive path. The apparently attractive payoff among names that later touch limit is conditioned on future information and cannot be known at 09:30. A low open is neither an automatic buy nor an automatic rejection; it remains watch-only until a real reclaim, volume, VWAP and theme confirmation occurs.

first_board_supply_summary.interpretation: With dozens of first boards, at least one promotion is almost guaranteed and is therefore a weak discriminator. High supply does not prove better per-candidate odds; its candidate promotion rate is directionally lower in both time segments, but uncertainty remains. Breadth must be separated from candidate quality and from verified theme structure.

promotion_payoff_summary.interpretation: Promotion describes continuing identity, not an executable post-fill payoff. A majority of promoted names fail the full-denominator buyable B+2-positive path, and fewer preserve positive marks through both B+2 and B+3. Promotion, buyability, multi-session payoff and big-loss risk must remain separate targets.

repair_followthrough_summary.interpretation: A broad repair has lower next-session relapse in the recent validation segment, but the effect is weak and uncertain in development. The repair score may describe the main scenario only; it cannot promise follow-through or authorize a stock entry.

repair_layer_summary.interpretation: Synchronized low, middle and height repair is directionally associated with less next-session relapse, but the recent synchronized validation group is too small. Middle-board confirmation also fails stable time-separated separation. Layer structure may describe a scenario only and cannot rank stocks or authorize entry.

high_to_low_ecology_summary.interpretation: Healthy ecology around height weakness is materially better in the recent segment, but development shows no adverse-state separation. The aggregate window may frame a high-to-low scenario only; without specific-theme identity and live confirmation it cannot select a supplement stock or authorize entry.
